'''2007 Massachusetts State Championship Chris Twiss LS Plead My Case To The Senate''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Chris Twiss]] at [[2007 Massachusetts State Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Plead My Case To The Senate / Sanity And Compassion|Cor-L-pleadmycasetothesenate.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Twiss
* '''Username:''' vader322
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
